name: ai-settings-presets
description: Presets set the AI fill sliders together: 'preserve' sets ai_force 0.5, style_force 0.0, trajectory 0.8, head 0.8; 'natural' sets ai_force 1.0, style_force 1.0, trajectory 0.0, head 0.0; 'follow_style' sets ai_force 1.0, style_force 1.5, trajectory 0.2, head 0.0. An individual slider passed with a preset overrides that preset value. A preset sets those four sliders only: the style stays as it was ("any" here), and nothing else about the fill changes. Only those three exact names are presets: an old alias or another spelling is refused (crates/ac-core/tests/commands.rs checks the refusal lists the three).
